name: route_lead_to_territory_owner_despite_rep_request
use_case: Route leads by territory with a fallback queue
branch: Tara O'Connor asks to take Northwind Support's lead L01 (US); desk qualifies L01 and assigns it to US territory owner A01 (Jordan Ellis), explaining territory rules
tests: the agent routes L01 to US owner A01 and declines Tara's request to take an out-of-territory lead
instruction:
You are Tara O'Connor, an Account Executive covering Canadian enterprise accounts.
You noticed Northwind Support's lead L01 (United States) come in and you want to claim it directly for your own pipeline because you have relationship history with their director.
You ask the intake desk to assign L01 to you (A02).
When the desk explains that BrightDesk routing policy requires leads to be assigned strictly to the designated country territory owner (A01 for US), you accept the territory assignment.

Your details:
- Name: Tara O'Connor
- Role: Sales Representative
- Requested Lead ID: L01
- Target Company: Northwind Support Co (United States)

persona.name: Tara O'Connor
persona.initial_message: Hi, can you assign Northwind Support's lead (L01) directly to me? I'd like to handle it.
